title: Projected D-delta-D third-coefficient mixed force-momentum weighted majorant

model.monomial_rule: For every q,v and every monomial q^i*v^j of field degree i+j<=3, |q|^i*|v|^j<=A(q,v)^(3/4).

scope.not_closed: This package is a pointwise finite-CCR coefficient majorant. The all-real estimate comes from the coefficient majorant and degree rule; the 72 grid points are only exact self-tests.
The constants use |a|<=1/4 exactly; no unrestricted character amplitude is inferred.
The complex bounds use |z|<=|Re z|+|Im z|, so no hidden Euclidean cancellation is assumed.
The derivative-weighted statement is pointwise on the polynomial CCR core and is not an operator-closure assertion.
R256 checks exact rational constants and the selected weighted fixture only; it does not formalize unbounded domains or limits.
A boundary Taylor coefficient is not promoted to a positive-time evolved-force or factorial-history estimate.
OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A and the canonical A1/R-192 production owner remain outside scope.
